title: Foreignಅಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಕಂಬಳ! 😍 Dr Bro
summary: The audience is overwhelmingly happy that Dr Bro is back after a long gap, and many say this is his best-edited video yet. Tulunadu viewers are thrilled to see a Kambala-style race abroad and want him to film the real one at home. A small but clear group asks for fewer meme edits and more frequent or multi-part uploads.
summary_hi: दर्शक बहुत खुश हैं कि लंबे इंतज़ार के बाद Dr Bro वापस आए हैं, और कई लोग इसे उनका अब तक का सबसे अच्छा एडिट किया हुआ वीडियो बता रहे हैं। तुलुनाडु के दर्शक विदेश में कंबला जैसी दौड़ देखकर उत्साहित हैं और चाहते हैं कि वे अपने यहाँ का असली कंबला भी शूट करें। कुछ लोग कम मीम-एडिट और ज़्यादा या कई हिस्सों वाले वीडियो माँग रहे हैं।

themes.label: Love and 'no. 1 creator' praise
themes.note: Respect buttons, 'zero haters', 'Karnataka's no. 1 YouTuber', Namaskara Devru greetings.

themes.label: Tulunadu and Kambala pride
themes.note: Love from Tulunadu, Mangalore, Udupi and Kundapura; people note their Kambala uses buffaloes, not bulls.

themes.label: Editing and videography
themes.note: 'Best editor', 'like a movie', 'National Geographic'; the editor gets direct shout-outs.

themes.label: Finally back, please upload more
themes.note: Fans waited weeks, rewatch old videos and ask for regular or more frequent uploads.

themes.label: Funny moments and timestamps
themes.note: Timestamps like 2:50, 28:03 and 29:25, plus viewers naming the tapir and the Rafflesia flower.

themes.label: Hometown shout-outs
themes.note: North Karnataka, Belagavi, Tumkur, Shivamogga and others checking in.

themes.label: Next video requests
themes.note: South Korea, Japan, USA, Finland, Mattur, the Indus Valley, Karnataka bull festivals, a Q&A.

themes.label: Too many meme edits
themes.note: A few long-time viewers feel the comedy cuts, especially at the start, have gone too far.

comments.author: @NethravathiKammar
comments.text:
Gagan  Brooo, 🥹❤️ It’s been almost a month… where have you disappeared? We genuinely miss your vlogs so much! 😭 Every day, I keep checking YouTube hoping to see your new vlog. And when there’s no upload, I end up watching your old videos again and again. 😂❤️

Your vlogs have honestly become a part of my daily life—something I look forward to, something that makes an ordinary day feel a little more complete. It’s almost like one of those little things we don’t realize we need until it’s missing. 🥹❤️

I know you have your own reasons for taking breaks, and I completely respect that. I just wanted you to know that your absence is genuinely felt. 🥹

Take care of yourself, Bro. ❤️ Whenever you’re
comments.highlight: It’s been almost a month… where have you disappeared? We genuinely miss your vlogs so much!
comments.why: The most-liked long comment says out loud what dozens of shorter ones hint at: the gap between uploads is felt, and fans rewatch old videos while waiting.
comments.reply: This made my day 🥹❤️ Sorry for the long wait, big trips take time to shoot and edit right. Next one won't take as long, promise!
